clue.text: Dire straits engulfing one ironic writer

indicators.note: the jumbled straits swallow up the letter for one, holding it inside
dire straits are a desperate state, so the word straits is thrown into disorder

parts.note: taken as written, as anagram fodder

explanation.surface: A mocking writer finds themselves in desperate trouble, or perhaps a nod to the rock band.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dire Straits' reads as a single phrase (or the band), but 'Dire' is the anagram signal working on 'straits'.
explanation.definitionFit: A satirist uses irony and ridicule to mock folly, so an ironic writer is a fair description.

clue.text: Journey east is rubbish

clue.text: A topless pie's rising layers

clue.text: Loving but discovered to have no heart

clue.text: Hold up Ecstasy to be swallowed by crazy lady

clue.text: Reverse of label the woman's to pull into folds of fabric
